title: Kagamine Rin — A Dreamy Mountain Of Grapes〔Part1〕Side Story (Part 1)

meta.Event: As the Leaves Change Once More

rows.Line: School SEKAI

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Hello♪
Thanks for having us over again today!

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Saki, Shiho, welcome.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Oh, we need to thank you two for those lovely souvenirs. We were actually having them together just now.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
Everything was so good!
But I definitely liked the warabimochi the most☆

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Yeah, those were really good. They were a lot fruitier than I was expecting.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
I know, right?
That means my instincts were correct!

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line:
I see...
I didn't realize that you helped them look for souvenirs, Rin.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Yup! Sakki said that we could look together♪

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
So, thanks for inviting me along!
You too, Shih! I really appreciate you letting me join you guys!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Hehe. You're welcome♪

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: I'm glad you enjoyed everything.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: We were hoping that you'd get to see a lot more...

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: No, don't say that! I saw plenty!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: You two were both kind enough to position your phones in your pockets in such a way that I could see what was going on.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Including the Leaf Ranger Tower♪

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Leaf Ranger Tower?

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Hehe. This is what happened...

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
<There we are.
I should be able to watch everything from here...!>

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: <Shih said they're capping off their trip by going leaf-viewing...>

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: (Wow! This is so beautiful...!)

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: (The leaves on these trees are all red, yellow and orange!)

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: (Whoa...! I didn't know these leaves would be this pretty!)

rows.Speaker: Saki's Voice
rows.Line: Shiho, look!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
(Oh, Sakki's coming this way!
She has something in her hands...)
se_run_women_003_1

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: I got a whole bunch of bright red leaves♪

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line:
Wow, that's really pretty.
They're all the same shade of red.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: I know, right?! Since we have all these pretty leaves, we gotta all transform!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Transform?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Ta-daa♪
I'm Red Leaf Ranger!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Wait, you're just covering your eyes using a pair of leaves...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Hehe. It's a fun way to enjoy fall, right?

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: (Haha! That's really silly, but it also suits her really well♪)
se_walk_men_003_1
se_walk_women_003_1

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
Oh, I remember that game!
We used to transform into all kinds of superheroes!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
Oh, is that true?
But it looks like fun, so I think I'll join you.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Wait, Shizuku, you're not actually...?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Then, wanna try on these yellow-ish leaves?

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
Oh, those look lovely!
Thank you, Saki.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
In that case, I'll use...!
These orange-ish leaves!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
(They're all getting into it!
That means Shih has no choice but to...)

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: I'll take a picture of you three if you all wanna pose together, Saki.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Wait, Shiho, aren't you gonna join us?

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Uhh, wait. I need you to move out of that tree's shadow. Also, you guys need to bunch together more.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Awww, Tsukasa!
Shiho doesn't want to play with us.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Hmm... Unfortunately, it just rained, so there isn't anyone else around who we can ask to take a picture of us...

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Shii, I'll swap places with you...

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line:
I'm good.
Anyway, squeeze together a little more for me.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: I know! What if we lined up vertically instead of horizontally?

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Huh? Vertically?

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
Hehe. That sounds like fun.
I'll be on the bottom. Saki, you stay right where you are.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Okay!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Then, I'll be on top!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
(Oh, they're lining up vertically!
Like they're forming a...)

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Alright, Saki, Shizuku, get your leaves ready!

rows.Speaker: Saki & Shizuku
rows.Line:
Okay♪
Okay.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Transform! I'm the Orange Leaf Ranger!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Hehe. Transform...!
I'm the Red Leaf Ranger!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: And I'll transform into...♪ The Yellow Leaf Ranger!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Together, we form...! The Leaf Ranger Tower!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
(...! Wh-What are they doing?!
Th-That's so silly... N-No, I can't hold back my laughter...!)

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: (Th-This is bad! I can't not laugh!)

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: I rushed back over here so that I could roll on the floor laughing♪

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
You saw all that, Rin?!
Also, Shiho, you laughed while you were taking that picture?!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line:
Hey, it was impossible not to laugh.
The worst part was how that image of you guys kept popping back into my head.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
I know exactly what you mean, Shih!
I couldn't stop thinking about what they did.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Oh, that explains why you've been giggling for no reason...

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Yeah, because it was really funny... H-Hehe... Haha!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: I think this means Rin had the most fun out of all of us.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Yeah! I'm really glad for her♪
